source: User revision on 2026-10-28 Asia/Shanghai: about 100 MEGA-CDP-CF development cases; automatic construction, program checks and existing path scoring; human spot-check only after stable benefit, before formal experiments.

data.source: MEGA-CDP-CF constructed from MEGA-CDP single-turn development guidelines
data.reference_requirement: unique correct path or explicit acceptable answer set
data.validation: Automatic construction and program checks only; semantic validity remains unverified
data.target_size_policy: Aim for approximately 100 base cases, each with native and counterfactual input; report actual counts, construction failures and coverage without selecting on method outcomes.
data.human_spot_check_timing: After stable P6 benefit, before using selected counterfactual data and scorer in formal experiments

methods.prune_exception: TS-Prune receives the same source guideline then applies its specified pruning transform

shared_cache.judgment_stage_comparison: same judgment and evidence reused across execution variants within each judgment condition

sequence: fixed blind/evidence: no execution guidance, matched zero intensity, mild gating, no-green
judgment stage x execution stage 2x2 ablation

metrics.statistics: paired bootstrap clustered by guideline; approximately 100 pairs / 200 inputs, not 200 independent patients; exploratory development intervals only

gates.intervention_coverage_interpretation: Program-verified span hit and applied intervention only, not clinically verified correctness

decisions.data_or_mapping_failure: Repair construction or mapping and retain failures; report automatically checked scope without claiming clinical semantic validity
decisions.generation_failure: disable green, narrow layers, lower intensity in the prescribed diagnostic sequence; stop execution-guidance route if persistent
decisions.native_harm: do not trade native harm for decoy gain
decisions.same_information_tie: no attention-superiority claim; retain diagnostic/mechanistic scope
decisions.cost_failure: remove low-cost claim and reassess application value
decisions.all_gates_pass: If benefit is stable, prepare human spot-check of counterfactual data entering formal experiments and the scorer; no formal clinical-validity or significant-superiority claim from P6 alone

runtime.long_context_vram_and_time: profile on server before full launch; P5 resource use is not a P6 estimate

pending: server execution access and current v3 completion check
automatic candidate construction and program validation toward about 100 pairs

evidence_limits.purpose: Decide whether to continue to formal-experiment preparation

revision_note: Supersedes the earlier P6 requirement for >=120 human-verified pairs and the human span-accuracy gate. Existing 20-guideline/40-complex-case coverage requirements and generation, native-harm, same-information and cost rules otherwise retained. Historical protocols and outputs remain in Git history.
